summary: Clearway kerb on an arterial beside the rail line; no verge, no parking.
reasons: Clearway and tow-away signs along it
Rail corridor edge, no room off lane
Arterial traffic, nobody parked at kerb

drivers.seclusion: Rail corridor on the van side and no dwellings within 35 m, but a van would sit in the live lane in full view.
drivers.access_and_room: The kerb is the outer traffic lane; only a thin strip of weeds lies between it and the tracks, with no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane arterial with steady traffic, plus the busy rail line alongside.
drivers.convention: Cars seen along the stretch are moving traffic; none parked at the kerb. Clearway signs with tow-away show stopping is banned.

flags: Clearway C and tow-away signs, Mon-Fri or Mon-Sat 7am-7pm
Low-lying at the start: about 9 m elevation, Toowong Creek 4 m away
Steep in places: 15% max grade, 3.3% mean
sun_shade: Tree shade falls across the lanes from the north side in the morning; open sun otherwise.
cannot_judge: Whether the rail strip could hold a van (it is rail land, not a verge)
